info.title: com.clodhub/money
info.description: Money as whole numbers of a currency's minor unit, with the currency's ISO 4217 minor digits, formatting by language through Intl.NumberFormat, reading prices written in text, and percentages: the same pure functions in the browser and on the server. Amounts are integers, so 37.50 EUR is 3750 and never a binary fraction.

methods.name: formatMoney
methods.description: The amount as the language writes it with Intl.NumberFormat and the currency's narrow sign: €37.50 in English and 37,50 € in Spanish; £12.50 and 12,50 £. With wholeUnits auto (the default) a whole amount has no minor digits: €45, 45 €. A negative amount that rounds to zero has no minus.

schema.description: A BCP 47 language tag such as en, es or de-CH.

methods.name: parseMoney
methods.description: The first amount in the text written with the currency's code (in capitals, small letters or with a capital first) or one of its signs before or after the number, spaces allowed between: 85€, 85 €, €85, 37,50 €, 1.200,00 €, 60,- €, EUR 60, CHF 60, CHF60, $1,200.00 (USD), £60 (GBP). Every script's decimal digits count, and direction marks are ignored. The last . or , is the decimal mark, except that a single one followed by exactly three digits groups thousands (1.200 €) unless the currency has three minor digits; spaces and apostrophes also group thousands. A number joined to a word (x60 €) is no amount. Null when no number carries the currency's code or sign: 50 minutes, 37,50, £60 for EUR, or an amount with more minor digits than the currency has. Whatever formatMoney writes reads back as the same amount, except a whole amount of 1000 or more units in a currency with three minor digits (KWD 1,000 reads as 1.000). The currency defaults to the installed setting.

methods.name: fromMajor
methods.description: Units (37.5) as minor units (3750 for EUR, 38 for JPY 37.5), rounded with Math.round after the binary error of the product is dropped (1.005 EUR is 101).

methods.name: toMajor
methods.description: Minor units as units: 3750 EUR is 37.5, 1200 JPY is 1200, 1234 KWD is 1.234.

methods.name: minorDigits
methods.description: The currency's ISO 4217 minor digits: JPY 0, EUR 2, KWD 3, CLF 4.

methods.name: percentOf
methods.description: Math.round(amount * percent / 100): half a minor unit rounds up (50% of 1005 is 503).

methods.name: settingsFrom
methods.description: Converts and checks setting values; a missing value takes its default.

methods.name: installedSettings
methods.description: The settings clod rendered at install (the defaults before installation).

Money.description: An amount as a whole number of the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR, yen for JPY, fils for KWD).

CurrencyCode.description: An upper-case ISO 4217 code with a minor unit (EUR, GBP, CHF, JPY, KWD); lower case and unknown codes are refused.

wholeUnits.description: auto: no minor digits when the amount is a whole number of units (€45, €37.50); always: rounded to whole units, halves away from zero (€38 for 37.50); never: every minor digit (€45.00).

symbolBefore.description: The sign before the number whatever the language, with no space unless the sign is written in letters (€37,50 in Spanish, CHF 60).

currency.description: An upper-case ISO 4217 code with a minor unit (EUR, GBP, CHF, JPY, KWD); lower case and unknown codes are refused.

MoneySettings.description: The installed settings: the shop's currency. DEFAULT_SETTINGS, an exported constant, is {currency: EUR}.

RawSettings.description: Setting values; a value still in its {{name}} form, as before installation, takes the default.

InvalidCurrency.message: RangeError: the currency is not an upper-case ISO 4217 code with a minor unit

InvalidAmount.message: RangeError: an amount is not a whole number of minor units, or a number is not finite

InvalidOptions.message: RangeError: wholeUnits is not auto, always or never

InvalidLanguage.message: RangeError: the language is not a well-formed language tag

InvalidSettings.message: RangeError: a setting value does not fit
